record.question: Who among the following is not considered the member of the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)?
options: chairman of the National Commission for Minorities
chairman of the National Commission for the Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes
chairman of the National Commission for Women
chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
record.explanation: The UPSC Chairman is not an ex officio member of the NHRC, unlike the chairpersons of the minority, SC/ST and women's commissions.
